i18n.zhSummary: 研究表明，用于减肥和改善代谢性疾病的GLP-1型肥胖治疗也能改善生物衰老指标，因此其作为抗衰老治疗的可能性正在引起人们的关注。后维戈比·蒙扎罗，除了减肥还能减缓衰老吗？首次出现在《麻省理工科技评论》上 |麻省理工学院技术评论韩国。
i18n.enTitle: Will Wigobi and Maunjaro slow down aging beyond weight loss?
i18n.enSummary: As research has shown that the GLP-1 type obesity treatment, which is used to reduce weight and improve metabolic diseases, also improves biological aging indicators, the possibility of it being used as an anti-aging treatment is attracting attention. The post Wigobi·Maunjaro, will it slow down aging beyond weight loss? appeared first on MIT Technology Review | MIT Technology Review Korea.
